subject.title: [Feature]: Prefer Volta shim path over version-pinned Volta node path for macOS gateway LaunchAgent

question: Should OpenClaw support `~/.volta/bin/node` as the managed gateway service fallback when the current Node comes from a Volta tools/image path and no supported system Node is available?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but accepting it changes managed-service runtime policy from warning against version-manager paths toward supporting a specific Volta shim fallback.

options.title: Review a proof-backed Volta fallback
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the candidate or replacement PR to prove an actual macOS LaunchAgent install/reinstall under Volta before accepting the policy change.

options.title: Reject Volta service shim fallback
options.body: Keep the current system-Node policy, document that Volta-managed service runtimes remain warned/unsupported, and close this issue after that maintainer decision.

options.title: Adopt the helper change without live proof
options.body: Accept the narrow resolver/test change now, but own the risk that Volta shims may behave differently in launchd than in an interactive shell.

recommendation.title: Review a proof-backed Volta fallback
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the candidate or replacement PR to prove an actual macOS LaunchAgent install/reinstall under Volta before accepting the policy change.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the current runtime-selection policy and recent daemon path history.
